add_subdirectory(croar)
add_subdirectory(monocypher)
add_subdirectory(sds)
add_subdirectory(cxml)
add_subdirectory(mir)
function(turbo_add_static_base64)
  set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
  set(BASE64_BUILD_CLI OFF CACHE BOOL "Build the base64 CLI" FORCE)
  set(BASE64_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build the base64 tests" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory(base64 EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endfunction()

turbo_add_static_base64()
add_library(aklomp::base64 ALIAS base64)
